q: In 2 Peter, with the Lord a day is like how many years?
why: God is not bound by time.
quote: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

q: In 2 Peter, why is the Lord patient?
why: He does not want anyone to perish.
quote: not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.

q: In 2 Peter, how will the Day of the Lord come?
quote: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief.

q: In 2 Peter, in what should believers grow?
quote: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

q: In 2 Peter, how did the prophets speak from God?
why: Prophecy did not come from man.
quote: but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

q: In 2 Peter, Peter says he did not follow fables but was an eyewitness of what?
why: He saw it on the holy mountain.
quote: but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.

q: In 2 Peter, what did the voice from the Majestic Glory say about Jesus?
why: God was well pleased with Him.
quote: This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

q: In 2 Peter, whom does Peter call a preacher of righteousness?
why: God preserved him in the flood.
quote: but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight

q: In 2 Peter, which brother does Peter mention as writing with God's wisdom?
quote: just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.

q: In 2 Peter, where did Peter hear the voice from heaven?
quote: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
